origin.description: The default method calls match. When x is atomic and has no class, a Date table converts x from days since 1970-01-01, and a POSIXt table converts x from seconds since 1970-01-01. Signed zero matches zero. NA and NaN stay distinct.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Values to look up. A plain numeric vector is converted when table is Date or POSIXt.

arguments.name: nomatch
arguments.text: Returned when there is no match. It is coerced to integer.

arguments.name: incomparables
arguments.text: Values in x that are forced to nomatch.

translation.example:
import datetime as dt
from zoo.match import MATCH_default
table = [dt.date(1970, 1, 1) + dt.timedelta(days=day) for day in (1, 3)]
print(" ".join("NA" if v is None else str(v) for v in MATCH_default([0, 1, 5], table)))
